items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: He went to, last time I heard from him, he was in North, you know, Alexander.

ctx.x: He used to hop around the drum and run with him and make a run. He's had a Cripple Foot. He went to, last time I heard from him, he was in North, you know, Alexander.
Mr. Jones is still living then. Yeah, he's over there. We'll have to try to talk to him sometime.
